# StagedProgress

Shows a long or multi-step job as ordered steps with honest state, the current step's detail, elapsed time, an estimate only when known, and Cancel where the j…

`SongNodes.StagedProgress` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.StagedProgress lead="…" title="…" steps={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.StagedProgress" lead="…" title="…" steps="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (StagedProgressProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lead` * | `string` | Thin–bold title parts: lead "Weekly build", title "Sat 24 Oct". |
| `title` * | `string` | Bold part of the title. |
| `steps` * | `StagedProgressStep[]` | Ordered steps. |
| `elapsedSeconds` * | `number` | Seconds since start; rendered as "Elapsed 4:18". |
| `remainingSeconds` | `number` | Seconds left, only when the job can estimate honestly; rounded up ("About 3 min left"). |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` | Cancels the job; omit when the job cannot be cancelled. |
| `runsInBackground` | `boolean` | True when the job runs on the server and survives navigation; shows the "You can leave this page" notice. |

### StagedProgressStep

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `string` | Step name, verb first: "Match plays to tracks". |
| `state` * | `"done" \| "running" \| "waiting" \| "failed" \| "cancelled"` | done ●, running ↻, waiting –, failed ✕, cancelled –. |
| `detail` | `string` | Current detail: "Matching 312 of 500 tracks", or the failure reason. |
| `done` | `number` | Items done and total for the running step; shows a neutral progress bar when both are known. |
| `total` | `number` | Total items for the running step. |
| `seconds` | `number` | Seconds the step took (done/failed). |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | Step-level actions after a failure ("Retry this step", "Skip MixesDB"). |
